 Vising: Our goal is to win against Neftchi, and the cold weather won't affect us
 Sunday 25-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 Vissing explained during the press conference ahead of the match that the atmosphere within the team is positive and that preparations are going well, despite acknowledging the difficulty of the task against an opponent with strong capabilities.
 Regarding the weather in Uzbekistan, the coach confirmed that the low temperatures will not hinder Al-Ittihad's preparations, pointing out that his players are ready to deal with various conditions, whether cold or hot.
 Vissing discussed the impact of match congestion on his tactical choices, explaining that the succession of matches makes it difficult to determine the right lineup. He also noted that implementing his style requires additional time for all players to fully grasp it.
 He added that some members of the team have already started to understand his tactical ideas and implement them, while others need more time to adapt to the new approach, emphasizing that development requires continued work and patience.
 Speaking about Neftchi, Vesing stated that he has followed the competitor and studied their capabilities, describing them as a strong team that is at the top of the Uzbek league, which increases the difficulty of the upcoming encounter.
 The Al-Ittihad coach concluded his remarks by confirming that his team will enter the match with the aim of victory, while respecting the opponent and preparing well for the details of the game, in pursuit of continuing positive results and strengthening their position in the AFC Champions League Elite.
 Jens Wissing, the coach of Union, emphasized that his team is looking to surpass Neftchi and earn three points during the match scheduled for tomorrow in the third round of the AFC Champions League Elite, benefiting from the players' high morale.
